review_description: I could not be happier.The quoting process, the installation and now the performance of the system was outstanding. Callum and the installation team were excellent and the quality of the solar panels and batteries were of a very high standard.Infinite quoted a very competitive price without sacrificing quality.Thank you.Mark Humphrey

Callum from Infinite came first and was punctual, polite, clear and well informed. The phone appointment booker was also very good.The installation was tricky for them due to the power board being on the other side of the house to the battery location but they did a great job with difficult cabling. Our terracotta roof tiles were fragile and they replaced a lot at their own cost due to the size of the job. The team were all friendly, tidy and professional. We are still waiting for the smart meter install (which is not their role) and Callum will return to guide us through the remaining management once that has happened. Have been recommending Infinite to anyone who has asked.Thought you might like to know that Damien Slaven from Soltek didn't want to come out until I'd seen his ballpark quote ("don't want to waste your time and mine"). When I told him I was interested in a SIGENergy battery, he criticised the battery and said they'd only been in Australia 6 mths. I said they were currently the most popular new battery and he said "Yeah, well there will be a lot of tears when they go wrong." He repeated this line to a friend of mine who is also interested in a battery. I looked them up and they've been in Australia two years. I was unimpressed with his approach.Renew Solar were very busy and by the earliest they could come to quote was 21 August by which time we had already confirmed with Infinite.

We used Infinite Electrical and Solar to install a solar battery. Callum was knowledgeable, professional and helped us choose the right system and sized battery for us. We received a prompt quote, and the job was completed exactly as discussed and at the time arranged. The crew that came out fitted the battery expertly and with no fuss, and no mess left behind.A great job from start to finish. We couldn’t have been happier with the whole process and can highly recommend Callum and his team.

Callum and his team were exceptional. On time, cleaned up after themselves like they were not even there. Except for our awesome new heat pump hot water system. Their plumber and electrician were extremely professional and did a great job. Can't recommend them more highly. Thanks Callum, and team.
New 8kw system installed after removing existing old one. 30kw battery installed as well. Great price and after sales service with professional installation. Highly recommend.
Whole experience was fantastic. The team was friendly, professional, and really easy to deal with. The install was super clean and done ahead of schedule!

Callum and his team installed a new Sig battery system with full 3 phase backup. They were extremely professional, punctual and accommodating to my requests. The quality of the installation is exceptional, and I would highly recommend Infinite Electrical And Solar.

Callum and the Infinite team installed a battery and gateway to complement our existing solar - it was a very positive experience.Callum was very responsive and knowledgable while were were assessing options, provided clear advice resulting in a good value quote.Installation was on time, the team did a very neat job.Highly recommended.

From the time of quote to install Infinite Electrical and Solar were sensational! The entire team were not only friendly but highly knowledgeable, always prompt and super obliging. Installed 29 solar panels, inverter and four batteries and could not fault the Infinite team at any point. An absolute pleasure dealing with them and super happy with the high quality product.

I decided to get a second SolarEdge battery. My original installers offered a good price but weren’t able to install until August, so I decided to get other quotes. SolarQuotes introduced me to Infinite Electrical and Solar. They matched the other installers price and said they could install in mid July. In fact the installation was brought forward twice. The installation went very smoothly. Callum and his team were very friendly and did a great job. Very happy!
Excellent service from start to finish. Good to deal with people who are knowledgeable about their product, and efficient when installing, left no mess.

The whole process was painless, with time for me to consider what I would like, rather than any pushy sales tactics. I was kept updated and well informed about what was happening, and am now loving having our EV charger. I would highly recommend Infinite Electrical and Solar.
Callum and the team took the time to ensure the best configuration of the heat pump installation. They kept us informed of every step in the process and their workmanship was first rate.

Found them from solarquote website for quotation to install an ev charger at home. Response from them was quick and including the on-site quotation which was received in the spot. They were able to organise a same day install but my schedule did not accommodate So the unit was install the following week, along with other electrical work I need done.The technician on-site who performed the installation was very professional too and got the job done precisely how I would like.There was however some issue found that evening but they responded immediately and fixed it the following morning.I would definitely use them again for any electrical work in the future.
Quick, convenient and friendly. Excellent product recommended and installed plus full Distribution Board upgrade. 5 stars
Callum took good care of us - walked us through the system benefits and costs as part of the quote. Delivery and installation was super fast.

Process from onsite inspection to installation was excellent.Plenty of information for the consumer that was easy to understand.The GivEnergy Battery charged up totally on the second day and interface with app works well.Very happy with installation and interested to see how the first month electrical bill works out.

Excellent service and really happy with the result.Installed a new battery for our existing solar system - quote was in line with others and good quick turnaround time.Install team were a pleasure - polite & friendly, even despite our annoying barky dog.We had some tech issues after install but they followed up well and ensured the final set-up was perfect for us, so very happy!
